subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Which read-only Gateway/UI surface should own configured route and ACP binding visibility for the Agents channels panel?
rationale: The requested behavior adds a new core Gateway protocol namespace and Control UI read model; current main has binding helpers but no maintainer-confirmed API placement for exposing them to the UI.

options.title: Approve a normalized read model
options.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

options.title: Use existing config data
options.body: Avoid a new RPC and have the UI consume the existing config read surface, accepting tighter coupling to raw config shape.

options.title: Defer the display
options.body: Keep bindings visible only through config/CLI for now and pause or close the implementation PR until a broader Control UI routing plan exists.

recommendation.title: Approve a normalized read model
recommendation.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans recent Gateway RPC patterns, method descriptors, protocol schemas, and the binding helper surface.
